File convert · In development

File converter

Images, PDFs, data and text, converted on your device.

Open now

File convert has these main features: Images to PNG, JPG, WebP, BMP, ICO and PDF; PDF to images, merge and split. It opens Any image, PDF, CSV, JSON, Markdown, Plain text.

In development: some features listed below may not be finished yet.

What you can do with File convert

  • Convert a PDF to Word (DOCX)
  • Convert a PDF to Excel (XLSX)
  • Convert a PDF to PowerPoint (PPTX)
  • Convert AVIF to JPG
  • Convert an ICS calendar to CSV
  • Convert XML to JSON
  • A free CloudConvert alternative that stays on your device
